catalog_name: AI1 Repair Knowledge Source Candidate Catalog
purpose: Candidate inventory for evaluation; not an active crawl configuration.
important_rules: Do not enable a source until access, robots.txt, terms/license and collection method have been checked.
Do not bypass login walls, CAPTCHAs, paywalls, rate limits or robots.txt restrictions.
Do not add BIOS dumps, schematics, BoardView files or datasheets to the main knowledge corpus.
Do not label ORA event-level repair attempts as technician forum diagnosis cases.
Mobile repair sources are categorized separately; mixed Apple and iFixit sources are explicitly marked as mixed coverage.
